description: Wuhan University, Southern University of Science and Technology and the Technical University of Denmark publish water-level and storage-change data for 338 Chinese reservoirs during 2010–2021. Satellite altimetry supplies individual-sensor and fused water-level estimates, while Landsat and Sentinel-2 imagery supplies monthly water-area series. The repository lists separate ZIP archives for locations, water levels, surface area and storage change, plus a README. It describes Shapefiles, an attribute workbook with reservoir uses and dam heights, and a 93-reservoir in-situ validation subset. The files are open and free under CC-BY-4.0. Sampling differs between satellites and reservoirs; a fused estimate is not a continuous operator measurement. The series could calibrate reservoir water balances or test remotely observed storage changes during drought and flood periods. They provide measured and remotely derived comparators for model-rat-reservoir-assessment-tool, although matching reservoir identifiers and vertical references must be checked before comparison.
